text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I heard the news, Chan! Today's your 
birthday, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
In that case, as a special treat, this 
Magical Girl Sweepy will show you the 
perfect spell!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, magic. How exciting... What could 
happen next?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, here I go! "Bloom☆Bloom— Flowers, 
bloom in full glory!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...That's strange, let's try one more 
time. "Bloom☆Bloom—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez! That makes no sense! This spell was 
supposed to cover the whole area in 
flowers!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it's gonna be—just you wait 
until next year! I'll definitely get my 
revenge... so remember that!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Does that mean you'll celebrate with 
Chan-chan next year too?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, you'd better be grateful! Because 
next time, you'll get to see even more 
amazing magic!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm so happy. Those words feel like 
a present in themselves.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget... our promise, okay? Chan-me 
will be looking forward to it.
